authentication: None since 2026-10-19 (design "Admin console without login"): no identity is required or recorded; anyone who can reach the Route may use every route

console_redesign.team_view: One week at a time with Run, Review and Publish steps; tab=publish shows the publish step; tab=findings with finding=<key> shows one finding; overview, findings without a finding, decisions and activity show the week's current step
console_redesign.new_runs: POST /teams/{team_id}/trigger accepts 1-12 repeated week dates (Monday 00:00 UTC) or the former run_at, with llm and submission_key; one week submits a manual run job, two to twelve submit a backfill; POST /teams/{team_id}/backfill is kept for compatibility

run_scope: An explicitly selected run must belong to the selected team
manual_window: Monday 00:00 UTC to the selected Monday 00:00 UTC; omitted API/CLI run_at selects the latest completed week
execution_lock: Database SQL session lock alerts-bi-weekly shared by manual HTTP/API and CLI runs, standalone CLI reports, weekly scheduling and deletion; held across scan, persistence and report writing, including model-off runs; standalone reports hold it before run-id/team lookup through the final file write; durable manual jobs also use this full-lifecycle lock
deletion: Same-site CSRF and confirm_delete=1; removes the run and run-owned records; shared caches remain
deployment: One UI replica/application worker, one dedicated manual run-worker; login proxy is the only service port
execution_runtime: Maintained alerts_bi_admin.engine source in the admin distribution; no runs package or listener

async_submission.concurrency: One active job; SQL session lock and active slot constraint; since 2026-10-26 a busy submission is accepted as queued whether or not a backfill is in progress (queued and cancelled jobs hold no slot); a submission for a week the team already has queued, pending or running returns 409; POST /run-jobs/{job_id}/cancel removes a queued manual job

synchronous_response: JSON summary and three CSV links; no HTML content negotiation or scorecard field

backfill.scope: One registered team per backfill; 1-12 distinct completed Monday 00:00 UTC window ends whose window start is within the 84-day Elasticsearch retention
backfill.locked_weeks: Weeks with a current publication for the team, or a queued, pending or running job for the team
backfill.model_mode: live, fake or off for every week; live by default
backfill.admission: Browser form with same-site CSRF and a per-form submission key unique across all clients; one run_backfills row and one queued run_jobs row per week in one transaction; no execution lock; every run job insert and run deletion take the team's transaction-scoped queue lock alerts-bi-queue:{team_id}
backfill.claim_order: Orphan reconciliation, pending job, queued manual jobs by submission, then backfill weeks by backfill submission and oldest week first
backfill.manual_priority: A manual submission that finds the slot or execution lock busy is accepted as queued (during a backfill since 2026-10-14, at any time since 2026-10-26) and runs before the next backfill week
backfill.weekly_priority: A weekly invocation blocked during a backfill holds SQL session lock alerts-bi-backfill-yield and waits up to three hours, polling every 30 seconds
